name: gitlab
description: Deep control of a self-hosted GitLab CE instance (live-verified on 19.0.0). MCP server: generic REST+GraphQL passthrough reaching all 177 API resource groups, plus 56 curated tools (projects, repo files/commits/branches/tags, protected refs & environments, merge requests + approvals, issues/boards/labels/milestones, CI/CD pipelines/jobs/artifacts/triggers/schedules/variables, runners, environments/deployments, releases, feature flags, Pages + custom domains, users/tokens, project&group access tokens, groups/members/invitations, badges, packages & container registry, webhooks, wikis/snippets, admin settings, import/export, search). 8-reference control skill (CI/CD, projects/MRs/issues, admin & self-hosting with the SSH-only hard limits, honest CE-vs-EE gating, GraphQL) and workflow commands.
